question.text: In an LLP-structured Cat III AIF, the Investment Manager is known as (in foreign jurisdiction terminology):

explanation.text: The Logic: In LLP/foreign jurisdictions, the Manager is called General Partner (GP); investors are Limited Partners (LPs). The Trap: LPs are the investors, not the Manager. Cross-Exam Context: Same nomenclature in XIX-A. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Align offshore marketing materials with the GP/LP terminology where investors are based.
